title: risk: wolfHSM factory accepts key_size < 11 for RSA
description: wp11_wolfhsm_alloc_key_priv() accepts key_size without validating it is >= 11 for RSA keys (minimum for PKCS#1 v1.5: 11 bytes overhead). A misprovisioned key (wrong size recorded locally) passes all validation at creation/login time and only fails at first C_Sign with a memory safety error (see wolfP11-snp7). Add: if key_type==RSA and key_size > 0 and key_size < 11, return NULL with a clear log message. This catches misprovisioning at the point of setup rather than at runtime.
